summary: Completed frontend testing of new features: Operations Client module, Notion-style filters, and Finance Invoices with month-wise report. Fixed critical PDF download bug. All features working correctly.

design_issues.screen: Client Form Modal, Invoice Preview Modal
issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement needed

action_items: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components in ClientFormModal.js and InvoicePreviewModal.js for accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: InvoicePreviewModal.js - Changed jsPDF import from default to named import and used autoTable function form instead of doc.autoTable() for jsPDF v4 + jspdf-autotable v5 compatibility
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Operations - New Client button opens ClientFormModal with all fields (name, phone, email, business name, website, service, source, status, value, address, notes), 2) Operations - Clients tab shows client list with columns (Client, Contact, Service, Status, Value, Actions), 3) Operations - Notion-style filters with Add Filter button showing options (Status, Priority, Assigned To, Service Type, Due Date, Created Date), 4) Finance Invoices - Month filter dropdown with all 12 months, 5) Finance Invoices - Year filter dropdown (2024-2028), 6) Finance Invoices - Invoice Preview Modal with Print and Download PDF buttons, 7) Finance Invoices - Monthly Report tab with bar chart and month-wise summary table, 8) PDF download now working after fix to use autoTable function form.

operations_page.client_form_modal: PASS - All fields present and functional
operations_page.clients_tab: PASS - Shows client list with proper columns

finance_invoices.monthly_report_tab: PASS - Shows charts and summary table
finance_invoices.summary_cards: PASS - Shows Total Invoices, Total Amount, Paid, Overdue

bugs_fixed.issue: PDF download failing with 'doc.autoTable is not a function' error
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed import from 'import jsPDF from jspdf' to 'import { jsPDF } from jspdf' and 'import autoTable from jspdf-autotable', then changed doc.autoTable({...}) to autoTable(doc, {...}) for jsPDF v4 + jspdf-autotable v5 compatibility
